title: Sears Radio Theater
paragraphs: Weeknight anthology with a different genre identity each weekday. Frozen GRH set contains all 129 first-season CBS episodes through August 2, 1979; later Mutual continuation is show history, not frozen episode coverage.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Fletcher Markle (director on 72 recordings, producer on 71 recordings, and performer on 29 recordings), Elliott Lewis (producer on 45 recordings, director on 43 recordings, performer on 8 recordings, and writer on 1 recording), Marvin Miller (performer on 32 recordings), Shepard Menken (performer on 28 recordings and writer on 3 recordings), Vic Perrin (performer on 28 recordings), Andy Griffith (host on 24 recordings and performer on 1 recording), and Cecily Tyson (performer on 24 recordings).
